sentences.text: A receptionist is handing a visitor an identification card.
The visitor is standing across the desk from her.
Several chairs have been placed beside the entrance.
A stack of visitor badges is resting on the counter.
A coat has been left on the back of a chair.
Three coworkers are sitting around a conference table.
One of them is pointing at a chart on the screen.
A laptop has been left open near the window.
The presenter is standing close to the screen.
The other coworkers are looking at the chart instead of their laptops.
A barista is placing a cup on the counter.
The customer is reaching for the drink.
More cups are stacked on the shelf behind them.
A second customer is waiting behind the person at the counter.
A few napkins are lying beside the customer's cup.
Two workers are arranging boxes on a shelf.
A cart is parked next to the boxes.
A sealed package is standing on the floor beside the cart.
The boxes on the cart have not been opened yet.
One worker is reaching for a box on the highest shelf.
A hotel employee is speaking to a guest at the front desk.
The guest is holding a suitcase by its handle.
An elevator can be seen at the end of the hall.
The employee is pointing toward the elevators beyond the lobby.
A luggage cart is parked near the front desk.
A vendor is putting fruit into a basket.
A customer is examining the items on display.
Several baskets are lined up under the awning.
Apples and oranges have been separated into different baskets.
The customer is standing beneath the awning.
What time does the sales meeting start?
At nine thirty, but the room opens at nine.
Great. I'll be there a few minutes early.
When will the new chairs arrive?
The supplier said Thursday afternoon.
Then we can set up the training room on Friday.
Is my appointment still at two?
The dentist has an opening at one thirty instead.
That works better for me. Thank you.
How long does the orientation usually take?
About forty minutes, including the office tour.
I'll leave the rest of the morning free.
Do you need the report today?
Tomorrow morning is fine, before the team call.
I'll send it tonight so you can review it.
Has the manager decided on a time yet?
She said she'd email everyone after lunch.
Okay, I'll check my inbox then.
Can we meet on Wednesday instead?
I'm out of town that day. How about Thursday?
Thursday morning is perfect.
Does the library open at eight tomorrow?
The weekend hours don't begin until ten.
I'll come after breakfast then.
When do I need to return this key?
Please bring it back before the office closes.
Is that at five thirty today?
Yes, but the front desk stays open until six.
Are we training on Monday or Tuesday?
Monday is reserved for orientation, so Tuesday is our first option.
I'll change the calendar invitation.
Why hasn't the presentation started yet?
The speaker's flight arrived later than expected.
Will we still finish before noon?
Yes. She shortened the introduction.
Is the client visit confirmed for next week?
They confirmed Thursday, but not the exact time.
Should I reserve the room all morning?
Yes, until we receive their travel details.
Where is the human resources office?
On the third floor, across from the elevators.
Thanks. I'll take the stairs.
Which platform does the airport train use?
Platform four. The signs are above the ticket machines.
I see them now.
Is there a place to eat near here?
There's a small café next to the bank.
Perfect. I only have half an hour.
Where should visitors park?
In the lot behind the building.
Is the entrance on Pine Street?
Yes, just past the traffic light.
Is the workshop in Room A or Room B?
Room B. Room A is being cleaned.
I'll update the sign at the entrance.
How do I get to the conference center?
Turn left outside, then walk two blocks.
Is it beside the hotel?
It's across the street from the hotel.
Where can I pick up my luggage?
At belt six, near the exit doors.
Thank you. I'll head there now.
Is the museum entrance on this side?
No, go around the corner near the fountain.
Thanks. I walked past it twice.
Where is the finance department now?
They relocated upstairs, beside the legal team.
I didn't see the new sign.
What's the fastest way to the post office?
Walk through the park instead of taking the main road.
Is there an exit on the other side?
Yes. The post office is beside it.
Where should I meet the driver?
In front of the north entrance.
I'll wait there with the luggage.
Is there a quiet place to take a call?
The small lounge is just beyond the elevators.
Is anyone using it now?
No, it should be empty until three.
Could you send me the updated file?
I just attached it to my email.
Got it. Thanks for sending it so quickly.
May I borrow the projector this afternoon?
Of course. Please return it before five.
I will. My meeting ends at four.
Would you mind holding the door?
Not at all. Those boxes look heavy.
They are. I appreciate the help.
Can you help me change my reservation?
Certainly. What date would you prefer?
Next Friday, if there's a room available.
Could someone check the meeting-room microphone?
Our technician is already on the way.
Excellent. The presentation starts in twenty minutes.
Shall I print copies for the whole team?
A digital copy will be enough.
Okay. I'll share the link instead.
Is it okay if I leave a little early?
Yes, once you finish the customer notes.
I'll complete them before lunch.
Could I have another day to finish the draft?
Yes, but we need it by Thursday morning.
That gives me time to check the figures.
Would you help me carry these boxes?
Sure. Let's take the smaller ones first.
Good plan. The large box is quite heavy.
May we sit near the front?
I'm afraid the speakers have already claimed that row.
Then we'll take the next row.
Can you translate this document today?
I can't finish it today, but I can start now.
That's fine. Please send the first page tonight.
Could you drive me to the station after work?
I wish I could, but I have a late appointment.
No problem. I'll book a taxi.
I can help you carry your bags downstairs.
How many coffees should I order?
Six regular ones and two without milk.
I'll write that down before I go.
How much are fifty color copies?
They're twenty dollars, including the paper.
That's within our budget.
Do you still have this notebook in blue?
Blue is sold out, but green is available.
Green will be fine.
Is delivery included in the price?
It is for orders over one hundred dollars.
Then let's add another pack of pens.
Does the lunch special come with a drink?
Yes, you can choose tea or water.
Tea, please. No sugar.
Is the conference rate still available?
Yes, if you book before the end of the month.
I'll make the reservation today.
Could you send us a receipt for the order?
It will be emailed after payment is complete.
Please use the address on our account.
Do these shirts come in a larger size?
Yes, but we only have the larger size online.
Could it be delivered to the store?
Certainly. It usually takes two days.
Can I change the number of folders I ordered?
Yes, the order hasn't been packed yet.
Please make it thirty instead of twenty.
Is the monthly plan cheaper than the weekly plan?
It is, if you use the service every week.
I think the monthly plan makes sense.
Can I pay when the chairs arrive?
We require a fifty-percent deposit before dispatch.
I'll arrange the transfer this afternoon.
Why is the final bill higher than the estimate?
The extra chairs were added after we sent the estimate.
Could you email a list of all the charges?
Certainly. I'll send an updated invoice today.
Why isn't the train here yet?
There's a delay because of track maintenance.
Then I'll take the bus to the airport.
Should we replace the broken speaker?
Let's ask maintenance to inspect it first.
Good idea. It might be an easy fix.
Are we still eating outside today?
The weather forecast says heavy rain.
I'll reserve a table indoors.
Did you find the missing contract?
It was in the shared folder all along.
Great. I'll send it to the client.
Which design does the customer prefer?
They haven't replied to the new samples yet.
I'll call them before we start printing.
Can we move the appointment to Monday?
Monday is a holiday. Tuesday is open.
Let's take Tuesday morning.
Why did the workshop change rooms?
The larger room has better video equipment.
I'll tell everyone where to go.
Why can't we use the large meeting room?
Another team reserved it for a workshop.
Let's use the smaller room and invite fewer people.
Should we send this lamp back to the store?
Yes. The switch doesn't work properly.
I'll keep the receipt for the return.
What happens if the speaker can't attend?
Her colleague can give the presentation instead.
I'll prepare a second name card.
Did the team approve the revised schedule?
Yes, but they want the break ten minutes earlier.
I'll change the printed program now.
Should we wait for the new posters to arrive?
With the event tomorrow, we should use the approved design.
I'll print it this afternoon.
Good. We can update the digital version later.
Good morning. I'm here to see Ms. Rivera.
Do you have an appointment with her?
Yes. We arranged a meeting for ten o'clock.
May I have your name, please?
Daniel Park, from Northline Design.
Thank you. I'll let her know you've arrived.
Should I wait here in the lobby?
Yes. Please take a seat near the window.
Her assistant will come down to meet you.
Great. I'll get my notes ready.
Hello. I have a reservation for two nights.
Welcome. Could I see your identification?
Certainly. The booking is under Mina Chen.
I found it. You requested a quiet room.
Yes, I have an early meeting tomorrow.
We have a room on the fifth floor.
It's away from the elevators.
That sounds perfect. Is breakfast included?
Yes. Breakfast starts at six thirty downstairs.
Thank you. Where can I find the lift?
Turn right after the café. It's beside the stairs.
Excuse me. I think I left my phone charger downstairs.
Was it near the check-in counter?
Yes, next to the small plant.
Let me check the lost-and-found box.
Here it is. Is this black charger yours?
That's the one. Thank you for keeping it safe.
You're welcome. Is your room comfortable?
It is, but the air conditioner is a little loud.
I'll ask someone to look at it this afternoon.
That would be helpful. I'll be out until four.
I'll leave a note for our maintenance team.
Will they need to enter the room while I'm away?
Only if you give us permission.
That's fine. Please leave a note when they finish.
Certainly. You can also ask for another room.
Let's try the repair first. Please call before entering.
The training group arrives at noon.
Should we order lunch for everyone?
Yes. There will be twelve people, including us.
The café has sandwiches and rice bowls.
Let's get six of each.
One guest doesn't eat meat.
Then make one rice bowl vegetarian.
I'll call now. Should we add drinks?
Water is already in the meeting room.
Good. I'll ask for delivery before eleven forty-five.
Hello, this is Maple Café calling.
Hi. Is there a problem with our lunch order?
We're out of the chicken sandwiches today.
What can you offer instead?
We can make turkey sandwiches at the same price.
That should work. Please keep the vegetarian bowl.
Of course. Will someone meet the driver downstairs?
Yes, I'll be at reception at eleven forty-five.
Perfect. We'll bring the receipt with the food.
Thanks for calling before you made the change.
Hello. I have lunch from Maple Café.
Great. Are all twelve meals here?
Yes, but the vegetarian bowl is in a separate bag.
Thanks for telling me. I'll label it for our guest.
The receipt is attached to the larger bag.
I see it. May I sign for the delivery now?
Of course. Please sign on this line.
Leo, the group is ready to take a break.
Perfect timing. Please put the meals on the back table.
I'll tell everyone which option is vegetarian.
The café included a list of ingredients as well.
Excellent. One guest asked about food allergies.
I'll keep the list beside the meals.
Please call the café if anything is missing.
Everything matches the order, including the separate meal.
Did you see the update about tomorrow's meeting?
I saw an email, but I haven't opened it.
The start time moved from nine to ten thirty.
Why did they change it?
The client needs extra time to review the proposal.
Does that mean we should change our slides?
Only the price page. Finance sent new numbers.
I'll update that page this afternoon.
Please send me the final file before six.
I will. Thanks for the reminder.
I updated the slides, but the room calendar looks different.
The meeting is online now.
Really? I thought the client was visiting us.
Their train was canceled this morning.
Should I send them a video link?
I already included one in the invitation.
Could you test the screen sharing before ten?
Sure. I'll join early and check the audio too.
Great. I'll bring the printed notes just in case.
Sounds good. See you online tomorrow.
Nina, can you hear me through the meeting link?
Yes, but your camera is showing the wrong room.
Oh, I selected the old conference camera.
Try the camera built into your laptop.
That's better. Can you see the price slide?
I can. The new numbers are easy to read.
I'll keep the notes open in another window.
Good. The client will join in a few minutes.
I sent them the updated proposal last night.
Great. We're ready to begin at ten thirty.
Should I open the call to everyone now?
Wait until the client joins, then share the slides.
Understood. I'll mute my microphone while we wait.
I have the latest price sheet beside me.
Perfect. I'll handle the questions about timing.
I'm calling about an order of twenty desk lamps.
Certainly. Do you have the order number?
Yes, it's four eight two seven one.
Thank you. The shipment left our warehouse yesterday.
It was supposed to arrive this morning.
I apologize. The delivery truck broke down.
When will the lamps reach our office?
The driver expects to arrive by four today.
We close at five, so that should work.
I'll send you a tracking link right away.
I checked the link, and the delivery is delayed again.
I'm sorry. The truck is waiting for a replacement tire.
We need the lamps for an event tomorrow morning.
There's another driver near your office.
He can bring ten lamps tonight.
Ten will be enough for the first event.
We'll deliver the remaining ten tomorrow afternoon.
Please email me the updated delivery times.
Of course. You'll receive a message in a few minutes.
Thank you for finding another way.
I have the first ten lamps for your event.
Thanks. Please leave them beside the loading door.
Could you check the boxes before signing?
Of course. All ten look fine.
The remaining lamps are on tomorrow's route.
Will they arrive before three in the afternoon?
That's the current estimate in my system.
Please call me if the time changes.
I will. You can also follow the tracking link.
Great. This first delivery solves the urgent problem.
Would you like me to remove the empty boxes?
Please leave them here. We may need the packaging.
Of course. I have a copy of the receipt.
I'll sign it after checking the last lamp.
I'll leave a copy of the signed receipt with you.
The printer stopped in the middle of my report.
Did it show an error message?
Yes. It says the paper tray is empty.
There's more paper in the cabinet.
I added some, but it still won't print.
Let me open the back panel.
Ah, a sheet of paper is stuck inside.
Can you remove it without damaging the printer?
I think so. Please turn the power off first.
Done. The meeting starts in fifteen minutes.
If this fails, use the printer upstairs.
The printer works now, but I can't join the call.
Is your laptop connected to the office network?
Yes, and the other websites are loading.
Try opening the invitation in a new browser window.
That worked. I can see everyone now.
Can they hear you?
Not yet. My microphone was turned off.
Check the small icon at the bottom.
There we go. Thanks for helping twice today.
The call ended. Can we print the final report now?
Yes, but use the printer on the second floor.
Is ours broken again?
It works, but a replacement part is arriving tomorrow.
I don't want to risk another paper jam.
Exactly. I sent the file to the upstairs printer.
Thanks. I'll collect the pages on my way out.
Check the last page before you give it to the manager.
I will. The chart should be in color.
It is. I selected the color setting.
The first page looks good, but this one is missing.
It may still be in the printer tray.
You're right. It was under another document.
Now the whole report is ready.
I'll take it to the manager's office.
Good morning. I'm here for the marketing interview.
Welcome. What is your name?
My name is Arisa Tan.
You're a little early. Please sign in here.
Is there anything else I should prepare?
The manager will ask about your recent projects.
I brought a few examples on my tablet.
That's helpful. She'll be with you shortly.
Thank you. I'll review my notes while I wait.
Arisa, I'm sorry for the delay.
No problem. I had time to look around.
Our first interview ran longer than expected.
Would you like some water before we begin?
Yes, please. Thank you.
I see that you've worked on several campaigns.
I coordinated online ads for a small retail company.
Could you describe one project you're proud of?
Certainly. We redesigned the customer newsletter last spring.
Great. Let's start with that example.
Thank you for explaining the newsletter project.
You're welcome. I enjoyed working on it.
Do you have any questions about this role?
How large is the marketing team?
There are five people, including the team lead.
And when would the new person start?
Ideally, at the beginning of next month.
That timing would work for me.
We'll contact you by Friday about the next step.
Thank you. I look forward to hearing from you.
Before you go, the receptionist can validate your parking ticket.
That's helpful. I parked in the visitor lot.
The exit is beside the café downstairs.
I'll stop at reception on my way out.
It was a pleasure meeting you, Arisa.
The community event starts at ten on Saturday.
I can arrive at eight to set up the chairs.
I'll bring the welcome signs and name tags.
Great. The speaker needs a microphone by nine thirty.
I'll test it when I finish the chairs.
What about the registration table?
I'll handle that with two volunteers.
Are we still serving coffee outside?
Only if the weather stays dry.
I'll ask the café about an indoor option.
The café can put the coffee inside the lobby.
Perfect. Let's change the schedule on the website.
The sound check still begins at nine thirty, right?
Yes. The doors open at ten.
I thought the guest talk started at ten thirty.
It moved to eleven so visitors can settle in.
That gives me more time to test the equipment.
I'll tell the guest speaker about the change.
Thanks. I'll update the volunteers this afternoon.
We're ready as soon as the signs arrive.
The chairs are ready, but one microphone is missing.
I saw an extra microphone at the registration desk.
That's the spare. Bring it to Hall A.
I'll test both microphones before the doors open.
The café has moved the coffee inside.
Good. It may rain later this morning.
Should I move the outdoor signs too?
Yes. Put one sign near the main entrance.
I'll tell the volunteers about the changes.
Thanks. We still have twenty minutes before visitors arrive.
I found the spare microphone, and both work now.
The first guests are waiting near the entrance.
Please ask them to wait until registration opens.
I'll turn on the lights in Hall A.
And I'll bring the name tags to the desk.
Good morning, passengers traveling to East Harbor.
The nine fifteen train will leave from platform five.
This is a change from the printed schedule.
Please do not wait at platform three.
The train is expected to arrive in eight minutes.
Have your tickets ready before you board.
Staff members can help you near the information desk.
We apologize for any confusion.
Thank you for your attention.
Attention, passengers on the Riverside service.
The eleven twenty train is delayed by fifteen minutes.
The delay is due to work on the tracks.
Passengers connecting to the airport line should remain on board.
Airport tickets will be accepted on the next express train.
That train departs from platform two at noon.
Please listen for further announcements before changing platforms.
We appreciate your patience today.
This is the final boarding announcement for the Lakeview service.
The train will depart from platform seven in five minutes.
Please check that you have all your bags with you.
Large luggage should be placed in the storage area.
Keep the aisle clear while other passengers board.
If you need assistance, speak to a staff member on the platform.
The doors will close one minute before departure.
Thank you, and have a pleasant journey.
Passengers with bicycles should use the rear carriage.
Please allow other passengers to leave the train before boarding.
The next service to Lakeview will depart in one hour.
If you miss this train, keep your ticket.
It will remain valid for the later service.
Check the display boards for any further changes.
Hello, this is Dana from Bright Dental Clinic.
I'm calling to confirm your appointment on Tuesday.
Your visit is scheduled for ten forty-five in the morning.
Please arrive ten minutes early to complete a short form.
If you need to change the time, call us today.
Our office closes at six this evening.
You can reach me at five five five, zero one four two.
Again, my name is Dana.
We look forward to seeing you on Tuesday.
Hi, Marcus. This is Elena at Shoreline Events.
Thank you for sending the updated seating plan.
The main room now has space for eighty guests.
However, we still need the final meal choices.
Could you email them before Thursday afternoon?
The kitchen needs the numbers to place its order.
If anyone has an allergy, please mention it separately.
Call me if you'd like to discuss the menu.
Thanks again. I'll speak with you soon.
Hi, Elena. It's Marcus returning your call.
I've just sent the final meal choices by email.
We have three vegetarian guests and one guest with a nut allergy.
I marked those details clearly in the file.
Could you confirm that the kitchen received it?
I'm in meetings until three, but you can email me.
If there's any problem, call my mobile phone after three.
Thank you for helping us prepare the event.
I also attached the final seating plan again.
The names on it match the meal choices.
We don't expect any more guests to join.
If that changes, I'll let you know immediately.
I know the kitchen needs time to prepare.
Please confirm by email before the kitchen closes at five.
Welcome to Harbor Home, where your week starts with savings.
Our store opens at nine every weekday.
On Saturdays, we're open from ten until seven.
The store is closed on Sundays this month.
For the next three days, all desk lamps are discounted.
The sale applies to items marked with a blue label.
It does not include delivery or installation.
Please ask a staff member if you need assistance.
Thank you for calling Harbor Home customer service.
You may return most products within thirty days.
Please bring the receipt and the original packaging.
Items bought online can also be returned in store.
However, made-to-order furniture cannot be returned.
If an item is damaged, contact us before visiting.
We can arrange a replacement or discuss a refund.
For more information, press two to speak with our team.
Your online order is ready for collection at Harbor Home.
Please bring your order number and a photo ID.
Collection is available from ten until six on weekdays.
Use the side entrance beside the parking area.
A staff member will bring your order to the counter.
If you cannot collect it this week, contact us.
We can hold most orders for seven more days.
Thank you for shopping with Harbor Home.
For large furniture, please park in the loading area.
A staff member can help bring it to your vehicle.
Please check the size before you arrive.
Some items may not fit in a small car.
If you prefer home delivery, call us before collection.
Additional delivery charges may apply.
Good morning, everyone. Here is today's plan.
The customer survey closes at four this afternoon.
Please finish entering any paper responses before lunch.
After that, the research team will check the results.
We'll meet at three to review the first report.
If you find duplicate entries, mark them in the shared file.
Don't delete them until the team has checked them.
Thank you for keeping the data accurate.
Before we begin, I need to explain one change.
New employees will complete safety training online first.
The in-person workshop will take place the next day.
Each supervisor should send the training link by Monday.
Employees must watch the short video before the workshop.
They can use a work computer or their own phone.
If anyone cannot open the link, contact the support desk.
We'll answer questions at the end of this briefing.
Before you leave, please check tomorrow's room bookings.
Two client meetings will begin at nine.
The design team needs the large room at eleven.
Put any unused equipment back in the storage cabinet.
Our cleaning staff will come through at six.
If you are staying late, tell reception before five thirty.
The side door will be locked after seven.
Thank you for helping us keep the office organized.
Remember to save any files you're working on.
The network will restart at eight tonight.
It should be available again within fifteen minutes.
Employees working from home will not be affected.
If you notice a problem tomorrow, contact the support desk.
The next team briefing starts at nine tomorrow morning.
Welcome to the City Transport Museum.
Your visit begins in the main hall on this floor.
The first gallery shows how people traveled by river.
From there, follow the blue signs to the train exhibit.
The short film starts every half hour upstairs.
You may take photographs, but please turn off the flash.
Food and drinks are available in the café near the exit.
Enjoy your visit, and ask our guides if you need help.
Welcome to the Riverside Business Conference.
Please collect your badge at the registration desk.
The desk is directly ahead of the main entrance.
Morning presentations will be held in Hall A.
The workshops begin in Hall B after lunch.
The café is located between the two halls.
If you need a quiet place to work, use the upstairs lounge.
Volunteers wearing yellow badges can answer your questions.
We hope you have a useful and enjoyable day.
Good afternoon, conference visitors. We have one schedule change.
The workshop on customer service will begin at two fifteen.
It was originally scheduled for two o'clock.
The workshop will still take place in Hall B.
Please use the extra time to visit the display area.
It is located beyond the café, near the garden doors.
Staff at the registration desk can provide a revised schedule.
Thank you for your patience.
The display area includes work from several local companies.
You are welcome to speak with their representatives.
The afternoon guest talk will still begin at four.
It will take place in Hall A as planned.
Please return to Hall B before the workshop begins.
We hope you enjoy the rest of the conference.
